summary: Backend-only testing of Custom Inbox CRUD and Sharing functionality. All 22 tests passed covering: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/inboxes, POST /api/inboxes/{id}/share (decoupled copies), GET /api/inboxes/{id}/tickets, and GET /api/users paginated response.
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ POST /api/inboxes correctly creates inbox with filter_tree, name, color, assigns owner_id
✓ GET /api/inboxes returns list of owned + shared inboxes
✓ GET /api/inboxes/{id} returns single inbox with proper access control
✓ PUT /api/inboxes/{id} updates name, color, filter_tree with proper persistence
✓ DELETE /api/inboxes/{id} removes inbox and returns 404 on subsequent GET
✓ POST /api/inboxes/{id}/share creates DECOUPLED COPIES for recipients (not linked references)
✓ Share endpoint skips self-sharing and non-existent users
✓ GET /api/inboxes/{id}/tickets returns filtered tickets with pagination
✓ GET /api/users returns paginated response {items: [], total, skip, limit, has_more}
